summary: Preserve JSON.stringify handling of non-finite Numbers and signed zero.

target.notes: Number serialization must use ECMAScript Number/ToString JSON behavior, not locale formatting or .NET non-finite literal names.

semantics.finite: serialize with ECMAScript Number string formatting required by JSON.stringify

caveats: C# serializers may reject or spell NaN/Infinity differently; neither behavior is equivalent.

tests.name: nonfinite object property retained as null
